Reviewer: wopr pool job unknown-4186, GPT-6 (Codex), mkinney/seat unavailable; did not write or refresh this PR.

Clean review. The PR is mergeable. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

I read the complete diff and checked it against upstream/main's current AGENTS.md. No earlier review or NeoTech change request exists on this head. `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` and the pool job identity are not set on this host.

The machine file matches the existing Haas conventions. The disk registry and embedded registry include the new file in the same order. Tests cover loading, mounting, the post properties, and the travel, feed and spindle limits. The [public Haas specifications](https://www.haascnc.com/machines/vertical-mills/vf-series/models/small/vf-2ssyt.html) support the travel and speed values. The decision file explains the holder, pocket count and coolant choices.

Tests ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-4186`. No GitHub runner ran. Trial merge `f8f5e38c04fe3e5c426bf3d9db8d5f8557c0aa93` has PR head `12c4d485ff1b3ae959adb777b326febb8cbd2079` as its first parent. Its second parent is upstream/main `e6849c5aea183b81135c8143955cc8c88a429a89`.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 21 steps passed; 0 failed; 0 stalled. Both selected crate builds passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps passed; 11 tests passed; 0 failed; 0 stalled. The release build passed.

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test haas_machines --test machine`: 4 and 57 tests passed after the mutation copies were removed.
- The quick gate ran `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, and `example_catalog_edge_work`: 43, 1, and 1 tests passed. Four catalog tests remain ignored.
- The light lane ran the motion library tests (7 passed), `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, and app `pocket_pass_start` (1 passed each).
- No fixture directory or import code changed. The extra importer suites do not apply.

Safety checks and mutations:

The new machine limits affect program acceptance. I treated these checks as safety-tier work. The PR supplies no mutation record. I ran two independent data mutations against copies beside the test binary. No tracked file changed.

1. Change the new machine's Y travel to `-406..406`. `vf2ss_yt_admits_extended_y_moves_that_vf2ss_refuses` failed at Y=-508 with the expected stroke diagnostic.
2. Change the new machine's spindle limit to `12001`. `haas_travel_feed_and_spindle_limits_are_inclusive_and_enforced` failed because the checker admitted the test's over-limit spindle speed.

Both mutations were red. Removing the copies restored green results for both complete suites. No recorded program, CL file, NC file, or golden changed. There are no moved goldens to inspect. No UI code changed, so before/after screenshots are not required.

Requested changes: none.

Not exercised: a physical Haas mill, a CNC controller, the browser build, and full heavy lanes. This review does not certify a physical machine configuration. The worktree and branch remain in place for the next review round.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
